provider: Scaleway (Iliad Group, France) - Generative APIs Serverless (pay-per-token, OpenAI-compatible at api.scaleway.ai; formerly 'Generative APIs', sibling product 'Dedicated Deployment' = ex Managed Inference)
region_dc: Paris, France (fr-par) only; Serverless models hosted in a single DC operated by OPCORE per Scaleway FAQ (checked 2026-10-21). Scaleway says it may add other European locations later and will notify customers when hosting moves from France-only to Europe. Zone is not selectable (no PAR-1/2/3 choice).
sovereignty_class: EU HQ (France, Iliad group) + EU DC (Paris, OPCORE): full EU legal sovereignty, no US parent, so no CLOUD Act exposure on the provider itself. Scaleway markets ISO 27001 and HDS (health data) and GDPR/EU AI Act alignment [uncertain: not re-verified on a certificate page this session]; SecNumCloud qualification NOT confirmed [uncertain]; BSI C5 not confirmed [uncertain]. Open-weight models only; no prompt training on customer data is claimed on the FAQ privacy section [uncertain: privacy section not fully read].
monthly_cost: Pay-per-token, no 24/7 floor. Free tier: first 1M tokens. Target workload 50-100 agentic sessions/month at ~30k tokens each (assume ~27k in / ~3k out): 100 sessions = 2.7M in + 0.3M out. mistral-small-3.2-24b (0.15/0.35 EUR per M): ~EUR 0.51/month (about EUR 0.2-0.4 after free tier). qwen3.6-35b-a3b (0.25/1.50): ~EUR 1.1. gpt-oss-120b (0.15/0.60): ~EUR 0.6. qwen3.8-27b (0.60/3.30, cached 0.12): ~EUR 2.6. gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (0.25/0.50): ~EUR 0.8. Pessimistic case where each session re-sends context across ~15 turns (45M in + 1.5M out per 100 sessions, no cache): mistral-small ~EUR 7.3, qwen3.6-35b-a3b ~EUR 13.5, qwen3.8-27b ~EUR 32 (lower with 50-90% cache hit, cached input billed 0.12). Batches API gives -50%. Even the pessimistic case is under 25% of the EUR 150 budget. Dedicated Deployment for comparison (always on): L4-1-24G EUR 0.93/h = EUR 678.90/month, L40S EUR 1.72/h = EUR 1,255/month, so far above the EUR 150 budget (billing starts when deployment is ready; POC at 8h/day on L4 would be ~EUR 150-225 [uncertain: derived]).
billing_granularity: Serverless: per token, minimum billing unit 1,000 tokens, billed per model and token type (input / cached input / output), invoiced monthly; scale-to-zero by nature (no idle cost). Cannot set a hard spend cap (only billing alerts; effective cap is rate limits). Dedicated Deployment: per-minute billing of the GPU instance while deployed, no pause.
setup_fee_and_lockin: No setup fee, no commitment, no minimum spend for Serverless. Exit cost is zero (OpenAI-compatible API, switch base_url). Volume-commit discounts/quota increases available via sales [uncertain: terms not published]. Egress is not billed per token on Serverless as far as documented [uncertain].
gen_tps_7b_q4: Not applicable to Bielik (not hosted). Scaleway FAQ states decode >100 tokens/s for recent small/medium models such as gpt-oss-120b and mistral-small-3.2-24b with streaming (vendor claim, not measured by us) [uncertain]. No llama.cpp Q4_K_M 7B number exists for this host.
prefill_tps: Not published [uncertain]. Indirect: FAQ says TTFT grows proportionally with input size beyond a threshold; automatic prefix caching with typical 50-90% cache-hit ratio for agentic/conversational loads (not guaranteed), cached input billed at discount (e.g. 0.12 vs 0.60 EUR/M on qwen3.8-27b). This helps agentic harnesses that resend 4-8k tool schemas each turn.
ttft_at_4k: No published figure for 4k prompt [uncertain]. Vendor claim: TTFT < 1 second for most standard queries with < 1,000 input tokens (FAQ, 2026-04 validation). The marketing '<200 ms TTFT' claim was NOT found in the docs or FAQ and is unverified [uncertain]. Expect roughly sub-second to ~1-2 s at 4k with cache miss [uncertain: inference, needs a live benchmark with a free-tier key].
concurrency_slots: Org-level limits, shared by all projects: 100 concurrent requests for all models (both payment-validated and identity-verified tiers); tokens/min per model e.g. gemma-4-26b-a4b-it 200k TPM (payment validated) / 2,000k TPM (identity verified), glm-5.2 200k / 1,000k; 20 concurrent batches (100 after identity verification). RPM headers x-ratelimit-* returned. Rate limits do not apply to the Batches API. KV-cache per 1k tokens: not applicable (provider-managed).
ctx_ram_headroom: Not RAM-bound (managed). Context windows: mistral-small-3.2-24b 128k (max output 32k); qwen3.6-35b-a3b 256k; qwen3.8-27b 256k; gemma-4-26b-a4b-it 256k; gpt-oss-120b 128k; llama-3.3-70b 100k serverless; glm-5.3 256k (1M planned). 30k-token agent sessions fit comfortably. Bielik-11B/7B native context (8k-32k) is smaller than any of these.
availability_status: Available now, self-serve signup, free tier of 1M tokens. Model status labels: Preview vs Active; Preview has no SLA. Catalog does NOT contain Bielik (no SpeakLeash/Bielik entry in the supported-models page as of 2026-10-21 doc validation). Custom model import exists only in Dedicated Deployment (beta, HF safetensors, needs a supported architecture such as MistralForCausalLM which Bielik uses [uncertain]); structured outputs and function calling are NOT supported for custom models, which kills agentic use of a custom Bielik there.
egress_traffic: No separate per-GB charge documented for Serverless API traffic; billing is by tokens only [uncertain]. Dedicated Deployment network egress terms not researched.
hosting_model: Managed API (Serverless). Provider owns inference stack, chat template and tool-call parser (vLLM-style server-side parsing, OpenAI-compatible); you cannot change the template or parser, and quantization/guided-decoding backend are not disclosed for Serverless models (mistral-small-3.2 is served as fp8 per dedicated naming). Model characteristics may change for Preview models; Active models treated as breaking if accuracy-relevant changes occur. Bielik is not offered, so a managed Scaleway deployment cannot replace Bielik itself; it replaces its role (Polish-capable agentic LLM) with other open models.
tool_calling_support: Yes, server-side OpenAI function calling plus structured outputs (JSON schema) and parallel tool calling on: mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct-2506 (Scaleway notes it is improved on tool-calling vs 3.1), qwen3.8-27b, qwen3.6-35b-a3b, qwen3.5-397b-a17b, gemma-4-26b-a4b-it and gemma-4-31b-it (agentic-tuned), mistral-medium-3.5-128b. Caveats: gpt-oss-120b tool calling only via Responses API (Chat Completions not supported yet); gemma-3-27b tool calling 'Partial'/limited reliability (deprecating). Reasoning effort param supported on Qwen/Gemma. Replacement verdict for agentic harness: best candidates are qwen3.6-35b-a3b (EUR 0.25/1.50, agentic-optimized, 256k ctx, thinking modes) and mistral-small-3.2-24b (cheapest, decent tool calling, good Polish among listed languages); qwen3.8-27b is Scaleway's 'optimized for agentic tasks' dense option at higher output price. Actual tool-calling accuracy vs Bielik not benchmarked here [uncertain]; published Polish quality of Mistral Small/Qwen vs Bielik not verified [uncertain].
spec_decode_support: No. Serverless is a fixed managed endpoint; no ability to attach a Bielik DFlash draft model. Dedicated Deployment custom models support only listed architectures (list includes EAGLEModel/MedusaModel/MLPSpeculatorPreTrainedModel as loadable archs) but no documented way to configure a draft model for a target [uncertain].
sla_uptime: 99.9% monthly availability target for Generative APIs per published SLA (applies from 2025-07-01; unavailability = loss of connectivity for >= 1 continuous minute per model Resource). Credits: 10% for 99.0-99.9%, 25% for 95-99%, 50% below 95%, max 50% of monthly invoice, voucher only, claim within 30 days with request logs. Excludes Preview/beta models, rate-limit overload, maintenance windows. No performance (latency/throughput) guarantee on Serverless.
llm_inference_tos: Yes, LLM inference is the product itself. Customer must comply with each model license (all catalog entries Apache 2.0 / MIT / modified MIT etc.; Scaleway says non-commercial licenses are waived by partnership). Prompts/outputs privacy statement not fully verified [uncertain].
price_stability: Mixed: per-token catalog prices appear stable but the catalog churns fast. Documented model lifecycle: Active models supported >= 8 months from regional launch, 3-month notice before EOL; Preview >= 1 month with 1-month notice. Observed 2026 deprecations: gemma-3-27b, devstral-2-123b, voxtral, pixtral, qwen3-coder-30b, holo2 (EOL Aug-Oct 2026), glm-5.2 deprecated 2026-10-16 with EOL 2026-11-16 (so ~1 month only after listing). Historical price hikes for Scaleway Apple Silicon (+45%) are a different product. Pricing history of mistral-small-3.2 specifically not checked [uncertain].
model_lock_in: Low lock-in on the API side (OpenAI-compatible, no proprietary SDK) but high catalog risk: Bielik is absent and models rotate; EOL traffic may be auto-redirected to a different model (e.g. mistral-small-3.1 -> 3.2, qwen3-coder -> qwen3.6-35b-a3b), which can silently change tool-calling behavior. Mitigation: pin to Active models, use a LiteLLM-style router with fallback to OVH AI Endpoints / self-host.
